```{r temporal-trend, fig.width=11, fig.height=5, results='asis'}
    cat(sprintf("- **DDT**: slope = %.4f log-units/yr, R\u00b2 = %.3f, p = %.3f\n",
                lm_ddt$coefficients[2, 1], lm_ddt$r.squared, lm_ddt$coefficients[2, 4]))
    cat(sprintf("- **PCP/PCB**: slope = %.4f log-units/yr, R\u00b2 = %.3f, p = %.3f\n",
                lm_pcp$coefficients[2, 1], lm_pcp$r.squared, lm_pcp$coefficients[2, 4]))
  }
}
```

### 14C. Spatial Cross-Validation (Leave-One-Area-Out, GAM DDT)

Each geographic area is withheld in turn; a GAM is fit on the remaining areas and
used to predict log(DDT+1) in the withheld area. RMSE and MAE are on the
log(DDT+1) scale.

```{r spatial-cv, results='asis', message=FALSE}
if (!exists("real_dat") || nrow(real_dat) < 20) {
  cat("real_dat not available.\n")
} else {
  if (!requireNamespace("mgcv", quietly = TRUE)) library(mgcv)

  gdat_cv <- real_dat[
    is.finite(real_dat$DDT_real) &
    is.finite(real_dat$LATITUDE) &
    is.finite(real_dat$LONGITUDE), ]
  gdat_cv$logDDT <- log1p(gdat_cv$DDT_real)

  areas_cv <- unique(gdat_cv$GEOGRAPHIC_AREA)
  areas_cv <- areas_cv[!is.na(areas_cv) & nchar(trimws(areas_cv)) > 0]

  if (length(areas_cv) < 3) {
    cat("Fewer than 3 geographic areas — skipping leave-one-area-out CV.\n")
  } else {
    cv_rows <- lapply(areas_cv, function(a) {
      train <- gdat_cv[gdat_cv$GEOGRAPHIC_AREA != a, ]
      test  <- gdat_cv[gdat_cv$GEOGRAPHIC_AREA == a, ]
      if (nrow(train) < 15 || nrow(test) < 2) return(NULL)
      k_cv <- min(15, nrow(train) - 5)
      m_cv <- tryCatch(
        gam(logDDT ~ s(LONGITUDE, LATITUDE, k = k_cv),
            data = train, method = "REML"),
        error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(m_cv)) return(NULL)
      pred_cv <- tryCatch(
        predict(m_cv, newdata = test, type = "response"),
        error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(pred_cv)) return(NULL)
      data.frame(
        Area   = a,
        N_test = nrow(test),
        RMSE   = round(sqrt(mean((test$logDDT - pred_cv)^2)), 3),
        MAE    = round(mean(abs(test$logDDT - pred_cv)), 3),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    })

    cv_tab <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), cv_rows))

    if (!is.null(cv_tab) && nrow(cv_tab) > 0) {
      mean_row <- data.frame(
        Area   = "**Mean across areas**", N_test = NA,
        RMSE   = round(mean(cv_tab$RMSE), 3),
        MAE    = round(mean(cv_tab$MAE),  3),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      cv_out <- rbind(cv_tab, mean_row)
      write.csv(cv_out, file.path(out_dir, "spatial_cv_loao_results.csv"),
                row.names = FALSE)
      print(knitr::kable(cv_out, row.names = FALSE,
        col.names = c("Held-out area", "N test",
                      "RMSE (log-scale)", "MAE (log-scale)"),
        caption = paste(
          "Table 3. Leave-one-area-out spatial cross-validation (DDT, GAM).",
          "Each geographic area is withheld in turn;",
          "the GAM is fit on the remaining areas and predictions are evaluated",
          "on withheld samples. Errors on log(DDT+1) scale.")))
    }
  }
}
```

### 14D. Recommended Next Steps for Predictive Modeling

| Priority | Method | Purpose | R package |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Empirical variogram | Quantify spatial autocorrelation range | `gstat`, `sf` |
| 2 | Ordinary kriging | Unbiased interpolation to unsampled sites | `gstat` |
| 3 | GAM + oceanographic covariates | Mechanistic spatial prediction | `mgcv` |
| 4 | Block spatial CV | Honest prediction error for autocorrelated data | `blockCV` |
| 5 | Random forest + spatial CV | Non-linear covariate effects | `ranger` + `blockCV` |
| 6 | Mixed model: species + year random effects | Partition spatial vs. temporal vs. species variance | `lme4` / `glmmTMB` |
| 7 | Temporal ARMA on annual means | Trend and cycle detection | `forecast` |
| 8 | Transfer to unmonitored taxa | Exposure prediction for new species/regions | GAM with species factor |

The distance-decay slopes estimated in this report directly parameterise kriging
variograms: for the exponential model the spatial range
*r* = 1/*b* (where *b* is the fitted decay coefficient). For DDT,
*b* ≈ 2.54 × 10⁻⁴ km⁻¹ gives *r* ≈ 3,937 km, indicating that samples within
roughly 4,000 km carry meaningful shared spatial information and are suitable
co-variates for kriging.

## 15) Spatiotemporal Scaling Model (Distance + Time)

This section fits a joint scaling model for contaminant similarity as a function
of both geographic distance and collection-year separation:

$$
	ext{sim}_{ij} = \beta_0 + \beta_1\log(d_{ij}+1) + \beta_2\log(\Delta t_{ij}+1) + \beta_3\log(d_{ij}+1)\log(\Delta t_{ij}+1) + \varepsilon_{ij}
$$

where $d_{ij}$ is pairwise geographic distance (km) and $\Delta t_{ij}$ is
pairwise absolute time lag (years).

```{r spatiotemporal-scaling-model, results='asis'}
if (!exists("pair_real")) {
  cat("pair_real not available — skipping spatiotemporal scaling model.\n")
} else {
  if (!"time_lag_years" %in% names(pair_real)) {
    cat("time_lag_years missing in pair_real — rerun real-data analysis chunk first.\n")
  } else {
    resp_vars  <- c("sim_DDT", "sim_PCP_or_PCB", "sim_isotope", "sim_overall")
    resp_names <- c("DDT", "PCP/PCB", "Isotope", "Overall")

    fit_st <- function(df, yvar) {
      ok <- is.finite(df[[yvar]]) & is.finite(df$distance_km) & is.finite(df$time_lag_years)
      d  <- df$distance_km[ok]
      t  <- df$time_lag_years[ok]
      y  <- df[[yvar]][ok]
      if (length(y) < 30 || length(unique(t)) < 2) return(NULL)

      st_df <- data.frame(
        y = y,
        log_dist = log(d + 1),
        log_time = log(t + 1)
      )

      m_add <- lm(y ~ log_dist + log_time, data = st_df)
      m_int <- lm(y ~ log_dist * log_time, data = st_df)

      b_int <- coef(summary(m_int))
      get_coef <- function(term, col) if (term %in% rownames(b_int)) b_int[term, col] else NA_real_

      data.frame(
        response = yvar,
        n_pairs = nrow(st_df),
        dist_coef = coef(m_int)["log_dist"],
        time_coef = coef(m_int)["log_time"],
        interaction_coef = coef(m_int)["log_dist:log_time"],
        p_dist = get_coef("log_dist", "Pr(>|t|)"),
        p_time = get_coef("log_time", "Pr(>|t|)"),
        p_interaction = get_coef("log_dist:log_time", "Pr(>|t|)"),
        R2_additive = summary(m_add)$r.squared,
        R2_interaction = summary(m_int)$r.squared,
        AIC_additive = AIC(m_add),
        AIC_interaction = AIC(m_int),
        delta_AIC_int_vs_add = AIC(m_add) - AIC(m_int),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }

    st_out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(resp_vars, function(v) fit_st(pair_real, v)))

    if (!is.null(st_out) && nrow(st_out) > 0) {
      st_out$response <- resp_names[match(st_out$response, resp_vars)]
      num_cols <- setdiff(names(st_out), c("response"))
      st_out[num_cols] <- lapply(st_out[num_cols], function(x) round(x, 4))
      write.csv(st_out, file.path(out_dir, "spatiotemporal_scaling_model_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

      print(knitr::kable(
        st_out,
        row.names = FALSE,
        col.names = c(
          "Response", "N pairs", "Beta distance", "Beta time", "Beta distance x time",
          "p distance", "p time", "p interaction", "R2 additive", "R2 interaction",
          "AIC additive", "AIC interaction", "Delta AIC (int-add)"
        ),
        caption = paste(
          "Table 4. Spatiotemporal scaling models.",
          "Positive Delta AIC indicates interaction model support over additive model."
        )
      ))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r spatiotemporal-visualization, fig.width=13, fig.height=10}
if (exists("pair_real") && "time_lag_years" %in% names(pair_real)) {
  resp_vars  <- c("sim_DDT", "sim_PCP_or_PCB", "sim_isotope", "sim_overall")
  resp_names <- c("DDT", "PCP/PCB", "Isotope", "Overall")

  q <- quantile(pair_real$time_lag_years, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  q[1] <- min(q[1], 0)
  pair_real$time_group <- cut(
    pair_real$time_lag_years,
    breaks = unique(q),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    labels = c("Low time lag", "Mid time lag", "High time lag")[seq_len(length(unique(q)) - 1)]
  )

  par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
  cols <- c("steelblue3", "darkorange3", "firebrick3")

  for (ii in seq_along(resp_vars)) {
    v <- resp_vars[ii]
    d <- pair_real$distance_km
    y <- pair_real[[v]]
    g <- pair_real$time_group
    ok <- is.finite(d) & is.finite(y) & !is.na(g)
    d <- d[ok]; y <- y[ok]; g <- droplevels(g[ok])

    plot(d, y,
         pch = 16, cex = 0.30,
         col = adjustcolor("black", alpha.f = 0.10),
         xlab = "Distance (km)", ylab = "Similarity",
         main = paste(resp_names[ii], "by time-lag tercile"))

    dseq <- seq(0.1, max(d), length.out = 300)
    levs <- levels(g)
    for (jj in seq_along(levs)) {
      idx <- g == levs[jj]
      if (sum(idx) < 20) next
      m <- lm(y[idx] ~ log(d[idx] + 1))
      a <- coef(m)[1]; b <- coef(m)[2]
      lines(dseq, a + b * log(dseq + 1), col = cols[jj], lwd = 2.5)
    }
    legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.75,
           legend = levels(g), col = cols[seq_along(levels(g))], lwd = 2.5)
  }
}
```

## 15B) Dyadic Mixed-Effects Spatiotemporal Model + Blocked CV

To reduce pseudo-replication from pairwise expansion, this section fits a
dyadic mixed-effects model with crossed random effects for both members of
each pair (individual IDs, species, and geographic areas), then evaluates
prediction using leave-one-area-out blocked cross-validation.

```{r dyadic-mixed-model, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!exists("pair_real")) {
  cat("pair_real not available — skipping dyadic mixed-effects model.\n")
} else if (!all(c("time_lag_years", "id_i", "id_j", "area_i", "area_j", "species_i", "species_j") %in% names(pair_real))) {
  cat("Required pairwise fields not found — rerun real-data analysis chunk first.\n")
} else {
  if (!requireNamespace("lme4", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("lme4", repos = "https://cran.r-project.org/")
  }
  library(lme4)

  fit_dyadic <- function(df, yvar) {
    keep <- is.finite(df[[yvar]]) &
      is.finite(df$distance_km) & is.finite(df$time_lag_years) &
      !is.na(df$id_i) & !is.na(df$id_j) & !is.na(df$area_i) & !is.na(df$area_j) &
      !is.na(df$species_i) & !is.na(df$species_j)

    dat <- df[keep, c(yvar, "distance_km", "time_lag_years", "id_i", "id_j", "area_i", "area_j", "species_i", "species_j")]
    names(dat)[1] <- "y"

    if (nrow(dat) < 100) return(NULL)

    dat$log_dist <- log(dat$distance_km + 1)
    dat$log_time <- log(dat$time_lag_years + 1)

    dat$id_i <- as.factor(dat$id_i)
    dat$id_j <- as.factor(dat$id_j)
    dat$area_i <- as.factor(dat$area_i)
    dat$area_j <- as.factor(dat$area_j)
    dat$species_i <- as.factor(dat$species_i)
    dat$species_j <- as.factor(dat$species_j)

    ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5))

    full_formula <- y ~ log_dist * log_time +
      (1 | id_i) + (1 | id_j) +
      (1 | species_i) + (1 | species_j) +
      (1 | area_i) + (1 | area_j)

    fallback_formula <- y ~ log_dist * log_time +
      (1 | species_i) + (1 | species_j) +
      (1 | area_i) + (1 | area_j)

    mod <- try(lmer(full_formula, data = dat, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl), silent = TRUE)
    model_type <- "full_dyadic"
    if (inherits(mod, "try-error")) {
      mod <- try(lmer(fallback_formula, data = dat, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl), silent = TRUE)
      model_type <- "fallback_species_area"
    }
    if (inherits(mod, "try-error")) return(NULL)

    sm <- summary(mod)
    cf <- as.data.frame(sm$coefficients)
    cf$term <- rownames(cf)

    get_cf <- function(term, colname) {
      if (!(term %in% cf$term)) return(NA_real_)
      cf[cf$term == term, colname][1]
    }

    fixed_row <- data.frame(
      response = yvar,
      model_type = model_type,
      n_pairs = nrow(dat),
      beta_dist = get_cf("log_dist", "Estimate"),
      beta_time = get_cf("log_time", "Estimate"),
      beta_dist_time = get_cf("log_dist:log_time", "Estimate"),
      se_dist = get_cf("log_dist", "Std. Error"),
      se_time = get_cf("log_time", "Std. Error"),
      se_dist_time = get_cf("log_dist:log_time", "Std. Error"),
      t_dist = get_cf("log_dist", "t value"),
      t_time = get_cf("log_time", "t value"),
      t_dist_time = get_cf("log_dist:log_time", "t value"),
      AIC = AIC(mod),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    list(model = mod, data = dat, fixed = fixed_row)
  }

  run_blocked_cv <- function(dat, model_type, yvar) {
    areas <- sort(unique(c(as.character(dat$area_i), as.character(dat$area_j))))
    areas <- areas[!is.na(areas) & nchar(trimws(areas)) > 0]
    if (length(areas) < 3) return(NULL)

    ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5))
    full_formula <- y ~ log_dist * log_time +
      (1 | id_i) + (1 | id_j) +
      (1 | species_i) + (1 | species_j) +
      (1 | area_i) + (1 | area_j)
    fallback_formula <- y ~ log_dist * log_time +
      (1 | species_i) + (1 | species_j) +
      (1 | area_i) + (1 | area_j)

    cv_rows <- lapply(areas, function(a) {
      test_idx <- as.character(dat$area_i) == a | as.character(dat$area_j) == a
      train <- dat[!test_idx, ]
      test <- dat[test_idx, ]
      if (nrow(train) < 100 || nrow(test) < 20) return(NULL)

      form <- if (model_type == "full_dyadic") full_formula else fallback_formula
      fit <- try(lmer(form, data = train, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
        fit <- try(lmer(fallback_formula, data = train, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl), silent = TRUE)
      }
      if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) return(NULL)

      pred <- try(predict(fit, newdata = test, allow.new.levels = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(pred, "try-error")) return(NULL)

      obs <- test$y
      rmse <- sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
      mae <- mean(abs(obs - pred), na.rm = TRUE)
      r2 <- if (length(unique(obs)) > 1) cor(obs, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2 else NA_real_

      data.frame(
        response = yvar,
        held_out_area = a,
        n_test = nrow(test),
        RMSE = rmse,
        MAE = mae,
        R2_pred = r2,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })

    cv_tab <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), cv_rows))
    if (is.null(cv_tab) || nrow(cv_tab) == 0) return(NULL)
    mean_row <- data.frame(
      response = yvar,
      held_out_area = "Mean across held-out areas",
      n_test = NA,
      RMSE = mean(cv_tab$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
      MAE = mean(cv_tab$MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
      R2_pred = mean(cv_tab$R2_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    rbind(cv_tab, mean_row)
  }

  targets <- c("sim_overall", "sim_DDT")
  fit_objs <- lapply(targets, function(v) fit_dyadic(pair_real, v))
  names(fit_objs) <- targets
  fit_objs <- fit_objs[!vapply(fit_objs, is.null, logical(1))]

  if (length(fit_objs) == 0) {
    cat("Dyadic mixed-effects models failed or insufficient data.\n")
  } else {
    fixed_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fit_objs, function(x) x$fixed))
    fixed_tab$response <- c(sim_overall = "Overall", sim_DDT = "DDT")[fixed_tab$response]

    num_cols <- setdiff(names(fixed_tab), c("response", "model_type"))
    fixed_tab[num_cols] <- lapply(fixed_tab[num_cols], function(x) round(x, 4))

    write.csv(fixed_tab, file.path(out_dir, "dyadic_mixed_model_fixed_effects.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    print(knitr::kable(
      fixed_tab,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c(
        "Response", "Model", "N pairs",
        "Beta distance", "Beta time", "Beta distance x time",
        "SE dist", "SE time", "SE dist x time",
        "t dist", "t time", "t dist x time", "AIC"
      ),
      caption = paste(
        "Table 5. Dyadic mixed-effects spatiotemporal model fixed effects.",
        "Crossed random effects account for pair-member, species, and area dependence."
      )
    ))

    cv_tabs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fit_objs), function(v) {
      out <- run_blocked_cv(fit_objs[[v]]$data, fit_objs[[v]]$fixed$model_type[1], v)
      out
    }))

    if (!is.null(cv_tabs) && nrow(cv_tabs) > 0) {
      cv_tabs$response <- c(sim_overall = "Overall", sim_DDT = "DDT")[cv_tabs$response]
      num_cols <- c("n_test", "RMSE", "MAE", "R2_pred")
      for (nc in num_cols) {
        if (nc %in% names(cv_tabs)) cv_tabs[[nc]] <- round(cv_tabs[[nc]], 4)
      }

      write.csv(cv_tabs, file.path(out_dir, "dyadic_mixed_model_blocked_cv.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

      print(knitr::kable(
        cv_tabs,
        row.names = FALSE,
        col.names = c("Response", "Held-out area", "N test", "RMSE", "MAE", "Predictive R2"),
        caption = paste(
          "Table 6. Leave-one-area-out blocked cross-validation for dyadic mixed models.",
          "Test rows include any pair touching the held-out area, reducing spatial leakage."
        )
      ))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r dyadic-mixed-graphics, fig.width=12, fig.height=9, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (exists("fit_objs") && length(fit_objs) > 0) {
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(7, 4, 3, 1))

  for (nm in names(fit_objs)) {
    fit_obj <- fit_objs[[nm]]
    cf <- as.data.frame(summary(fit_obj$model)$coefficients)
    cf$term <- rownames(cf)
    keep <- cf$term %in% c("log_dist", "log_time", "log_dist:log_time")
    cf <- cf[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    labs <- c(log_dist = "Distance", log_time = "Time lag", `log_dist:log_time` = "Distance x Time")
    xpos <- seq_len(nrow(cf))
    ylim_r <- range(c(cf$Estimate - 1.96 * cf$`Std. Error`, cf$Estimate + 1.96 * cf$`Std. Error`, 0))

    plot(xpos, cf$Estimate,
         ylim = ylim_r,
         xlim = c(0.5, nrow(cf) + 0.5),
         xaxt = "n",
         xlab = "",
         ylab = "Coefficient estimate",
         main = paste(c(sim_overall = "Overall", sim_DDT = "DDT")[nm], "mixed model"),
         pch = 19,
         col = if (nm == "sim_overall") "darkorchid4" else "firebrick")
    axis(1, at = xpos, labels = labs[cf$term], las = 2)
    abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey50")
    segments(xpos, cf$Estimate - 1.96 * cf$`Std. Error`,
             xpos, cf$Estimate + 1.96 * cf$`Std. Error`,
             lwd = 2,
             col = if (nm == "sim_overall") "darkorchid4" else "firebrick")
  }

  if (exists("cv_tabs") && !is.null(cv_tabs) && nrow(cv_tabs) > 0) {
    cv_plot <- cv_tabs[cv_tabs$held_out_area != "Mean across held-out areas", ]
    areas <- unique(cv_plot$held_out_area)
    responses <- unique(cv_plot$response)
    rmse_mat <- sapply(responses, function(resp) cv_plot$RMSE[match(areas, cv_plot$held_out_area[cv_plot$response == resp])])
    r2_mat <- sapply(responses, function(resp) cv_plot$R2_pred[match(areas, cv_plot$held_out_area[cv_plot$response == resp])])
    if (is.null(dim(rmse_mat))) rmse_mat <- matrix(rmse_mat, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(areas, responses))
    if (is.null(dim(r2_mat))) r2_mat <- matrix(r2_mat, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(areas, responses))

    barplot(t(rmse_mat), beside = TRUE,
            col = c("darkorchid4", "firebrick")[seq_len(ncol(rmse_mat))],
            names.arg = areas,
            las = 2,
            ylab = "Blocked CV RMSE",
            main = "Dyadic mixed model blocked CV")
    legend("topright", bty = "n",
           legend = c(sim_overall = "Overall", sim_DDT = "DDT")[colnames(rmse_mat)],
           fill = c("darkorchid4", "firebrick")[seq_len(ncol(rmse_mat))])

    matplot(seq_along(areas), r2_mat,
            type = "b", pch = 19, lty = 1,
            col = c("darkorchid4", "firebrick")[seq_len(ncol(r2_mat))],
            xaxt = "n",
            xlab = "Held-out area",
            ylab = expression(R^2),
            main = "Dyadic mixed model predictive fit")
    axis(1, at = seq_along(areas), labels = areas, las = 2)
    legend("topright", bty = "n",
           legend = c(sim_overall = "Overall", sim_DDT = "DDT")[colnames(r2_mat)],
           col = c("darkorchid4", "firebrick")[seq_len(ncol(r2_mat))],
           lty = 1, pch = 19)
  } else {
    plot.new(); title("Blocked CV RMSE")
    plot.new(); title("Blocked CV predictive fit")
  }
}
```

## 15C) Trophic Covariate Extension for Transferability

We do not yet have tracking-derived movement covariates in this dataset, so the
highest-value biodiversity extension currently available is a **trophic proxy**
model. Here, pairwise differences in $\delta^{15}N$ and $\delta^{13}C$ are used
as proxies for trophic-position mismatch and habitat/foraging mismatch,
respectively. These covariates test whether Gulf-of-Alaska transfer improves
when ecological similarity is modeled alongside space and time.

```{r dyadic-trophic-extension, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!exists("pair_real")) {
  cat("pair_real not available — skipping trophic extension.\n")
} else {
  if (!exists("real_dat")) {
    fp <- file.path(out_dir, "real_testcase_prepared_data.csv")
    if (file.exists(fp)) real_dat <- read.csv(fp, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  if (!exists("real_dat") || !all(c("GUALIQUOTID", "delta13C_real", "delta15N_real") %in% names(real_dat))) {
    cat("real_dat with isotope fields not available — skipping trophic extension.\n")
  } else {
    iso_map <- real_dat[, c("GUALIQUOTID", "delta13C_real", "delta15N_real")]
    iso_i <- iso_map
    names(iso_i) <- c("id_i", "delta13C_i", "delta15N_i")
    iso_j <- iso_map
    names(iso_j) <- c("id_j", "delta13C_j", "delta15N_j")

    pair_trophic <- merge(pair_real, iso_i, by = "id_i", all.x = TRUE)
    pair_trophic <- merge(pair_trophic, iso_j, by = "id_j", all.x = TRUE)

    pair_trophic$trophic_diff_n15 <- abs(pair_trophic$delta15N_i - pair_trophic$delta15N_j)
    pair_trophic$habitat_diff_c13 <- abs(pair_trophic$delta13C_i - pair_trophic$delta13C_j)
    pair_trophic$mean_trophic_n15 <- rowMeans(cbind(pair_trophic$delta15N_i, pair_trophic$delta15N_j), na.rm = TRUE)
    pair_trophic$mean_habitat_c13 <- rowMeans(cbind(pair_trophic$delta13C_i, pair_trophic$delta13C_j), na.rm = TRUE)

    fit_dyadic_trophic <- function(df, yvar) {
      keep <- is.finite(df[[yvar]]) &
        is.finite(df$distance_km) & is.finite(df$time_lag_years) &
        is.finite(df$trophic_diff_n15) & is.finite(df$habitat_diff_c13) &
        is.finite(df$mean_trophic_n15) & is.finite(df$mean_habitat_c13) &
        !is.na(df$id_i) & !is.na(df$id_j) & !is.na(df$area_i) & !is.na(df$area_j) &
        !is.na(df$species_i) & !is.na(df$species_j)

      dat <- df[keep, c(
        yvar, "distance_km", "time_lag_years",
        "trophic_diff_n15", "habitat_diff_c13", "mean_trophic_n15", "mean_habitat_c13",
        "id_i", "id_j", "area_i", "area_j", "species_i", "species_j"
      )]
      names(dat)[1] <- "y"
      if (nrow(dat) < 100) return(NULL)

      dat$log_dist <- log(dat$distance_km + 1)
      dat$log_time <- log(dat$time_lag_years + 1)
      dat$id_i <- as.factor(dat$id_i)
      dat$id_j <- as.factor(dat$id_j)
      dat$area_i <- as.factor(dat$area_i)
      dat$area_j <- as.factor(dat$area_j)
      dat$species_i <- as.factor(dat$species_i)
      dat$species_j <- as.factor(dat$species_j)

      ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5))

      form_full <- y ~ log_dist * log_time + trophic_diff_n15 + habitat_diff_c13 +
        mean_trophic_n15 + mean_habitat_c13 +
        (1 | id_i) + (1 | id_j) +
        (1 | species_i) + (1 | species_j) +
        (1 | area_i) + (1 | area_j)

      form_fallback <- y ~ log_dist * log_time + trophic_diff_n15 + habitat_diff_c13 +
        mean_trophic_n15 + mean_habitat_c13 +
        (1 | species_i) + (1 | species_j) +
        (1 | area_i) + (1 | area_j)

      mod <- try(lmer(form_full, data = dat, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl), silent = TRUE)
      model_type <- "trophic_full_dyadic"
      if (inherits(mod, "try-error")) {
        mod <- try(lmer(form_fallback, data = dat, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl), silent = TRUE)
        model_type <- "trophic_fallback_species_area"
      }
      if (inherits(mod, "try-error")) return(NULL)

      sm <- summary(mod)
      cf <- as.data.frame(sm$coefficients)
      cf$term <- rownames(cf)

      get_cf <- function(term, colname) {
        if (!(term %in% cf$term)) return(NA_real_)
        cf[cf$term == term, colname][1]
      }

      fixed_row <- data.frame(
        response = yvar,
        model_type = model_type,
        n_pairs = nrow(dat),
        beta_dist = get_cf("log_dist", "Estimate"),
        beta_time = get_cf("log_time", "Estimate"),
        beta_dist_time = get_cf("log_dist:log_time", "Estimate"),
        beta_trophic_diff = get_cf("trophic_diff_n15", "Estimate"),
        beta_habitat_diff = get_cf("habitat_diff_c13", "Estimate"),
        beta_mean_trophic = get_cf("mean_trophic_n15", "Estimate"),
        beta_mean_habitat = get_cf("mean_habitat_c13", "Estimate"),
        AIC = AIC(mod),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      list(model = mod, data = dat, fixed = fixed_row)
    }

    run_blocked_cv_trophic <- function(dat, model_type, yvar) {
      areas <- sort(unique(c(as.character(dat$area_i), as.character(dat$area_j))))
      areas <- areas[!is.na(areas) & nchar(trimws(areas)) > 0]
      if (length(areas) < 3) return(NULL)

      ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5))
      form_full <- y ~ log_dist * log_time + trophic_diff_n15 + habitat_diff_c13 +
        mean_trophic_n15 + mean_habitat_c13 +
        (1 | id_i) + (1 | id_j) +
        (1 | species_i) + (1 | species_j) +
        (1 | area_i) + (1 | area_j)
      form_fallback <- y ~ log_dist * log_time + trophic_diff_n15 + habitat_diff_c13 +
        mean_trophic_n15 + mean_habitat_c13 +
        (1 | species_i) + (1 | species_j) +
        (1 | area_i) + (1 | area_j)

      cv_rows <- lapply(areas, function(a) {
        test_idx <- as.character(dat$area_i) == a | as.character(dat$area_j) == a
        train <- dat[!test_idx, ]
        test <- dat[test_idx, ]
        if (nrow(train) < 100 || nrow(test) < 20) return(NULL)

        form <- if (model_type == "trophic_full_dyadic") form_full else form_fallback
        fit <- try(lmer(form, data = train, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl), silent = TRUE)
        if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
          fit <- try(lmer(form_fallback, data = train, REML = FALSE, control = ctrl), silent = TRUE)
        }
        if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) return(NULL)

        pred <- try(predict(fit, newdata = test, allow.new.levels = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
        if (inherits(pred, "try-error")) return(NULL)

        obs <- test$y
        data.frame(
          response = yvar,
          held_out_area = a,
          n_test = nrow(test),
          RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
          MAE = mean(abs(obs - pred), na.rm = TRUE),
          R2_pred = if (length(unique(obs)) > 1) cor(obs, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2 else NA_real_,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      })

      cv_tab <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), cv_rows))
      if (is.null(cv_tab) || nrow(cv_tab) == 0) return(NULL)
      mean_row <- data.frame(
        response = yvar,
        held_out_area = "Mean across held-out areas",
        n_test = NA,
        RMSE = mean(cv_tab$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
        MAE = mean(cv_tab$MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
        R2_pred = mean(cv_tab$R2_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      rbind(cv_tab, mean_row)
    }

    targets <- c("sim_overall", "sim_DDT")
    trophic_objs <- lapply(targets, function(v) fit_dyadic_trophic(pair_trophic, v))
    names(trophic_objs) <- targets
    trophic_objs <- trophic_objs[!vapply(trophic_objs, is.null, logical(1))]

    if (length(trophic_objs) == 0) {
      cat("Trophic mixed-effects models failed or insufficient data.\n")
    } else {
      trophic_fixed <- do.call(rbind, lapply(trophic_objs, function(x) x$fixed))
      trophic_fixed$response <- c(sim_overall = "Overall", sim_DDT = "DDT")[trophic_fixed$response]
      num_cols <- setdiff(names(trophic_fixed), c("response", "model_type"))
      trophic_fixed[num_cols] <- lapply(trophic_fixed[num_cols], function(x) round(x, 4))
      write.csv(trophic_fixed, file.path(out_dir, "dyadic_trophic_model_fixed_effects.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

      print(knitr::kable(
        trophic_fixed,
        row.names = FALSE,
        col.names = c(
          "Response", "Model", "N pairs", "Beta distance", "Beta time", "Beta distance x time",
          "Beta trophic diff", "Beta habitat diff", "Beta mean trophic", "Beta mean habitat", "AIC"
        ),
        caption = paste(
          "Table 7. Trophic-augmented dyadic mixed-effects models.",
          "New biodiversity covariates are isotope-derived trophic and habitat proxies."
        )
      ))

      trophic_cv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(trophic_objs), function(v) {
        run_blocked_cv_trophic(trophic_objs[[v]]$data, trophic_objs[[v]]$fixed$model_type[1], v)
      }))

      if (!is.null(trophic_cv) && nrow(trophic_cv) > 0) {
        trophic_cv$response <- c(sim_overall = "Overall", sim_DDT = "DDT")[trophic_cv$response]
        num_cols <- c("n_test", "RMSE", "MAE", "R2_pred")
        for (nc in num_cols) {
          if (nc %in% names(trophic_cv)) trophic_cv[[nc]] <- round(trophic_cv[[nc]], 4)
        }
        write.csv(trophic_cv, file.path(out_dir, "dyadic_trophic_model_blocked_cv.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

        base_cv_fp <- file.path(out_dir, "dyadic_mixed_model_blocked_cv.csv")
        if (file.exists(base_cv_fp)) {
          base_cv <- read.csv(base_cv_fp, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
          base_cv$model <- "Baseline mixed model"
          trophic_cv$model <- "Trophic mixed model"

          compare_cv <- rbind(base_cv, trophic_cv)
          keep_rows <- compare_cv$held_out_area %in% c("Gulf of Alaska", "Mean across held-out areas")
          compare_cv <- compare_cv[keep_rows, c("response", "model", "held_out_area", "RMSE", "MAE", "R2_pred")]
          names(compare_cv) <- c("Response", "Model", "Held-out area", "RMSE", "MAE", "Predictive_R2")
          write.csv(compare_cv, file.path(out_dir, "dyadic_trophic_transfer_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

          print(knitr::kable(
            compare_cv,
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = c("Response", "Model", "Held-out area", "RMSE", "MAE", "Predictive R2"),
            caption = paste(
              "Table 8. Transfer-performance comparison for the baseline versus trophic-augmented mixed models.",
              "Rows highlight Gulf of Alaska and the mean across held-out areas."
            )
          ))

          gulf_compare <- compare_cv[compare_cv$`Held-out area` == "Gulf of Alaska", ]
          if (nrow(gulf_compare) > 0) {
            cat("\nGulf of Alaska remains the hardest transfer domain. The trophic extension should be interpreted as a first biodiversity-aware stress test, not a full ecological solution; meaningful further gains will likely require explicit movement/connectivity covariates or oceanographic predictors.\n")
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r dyadic-trophic-graphics, fig.width=12, fig.height=9, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (exists("trophic_objs") && length(trophic_objs) > 0) {
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(8, 4, 3, 1))

  for (nm in names(trophic_objs)) {
    fit_obj <- trophic_objs[[nm]]
    cf <- fixef(fit_obj$model)
    keep_terms <- c("log_dist", "log_time", "log_dist:log_time", "trophic_diff_n15", "habitat_diff_c13")
    cf <- cf[names(cf) %in% keep_terms]
    labs <- c(
      log_dist = "Distance",
      log_time = "Time lag",
      `log_dist:log_time` = "Distance x Time",
      trophic_diff_n15 = expression(Delta*delta^{15}*N),
      habitat_diff_c13 = expression(Delta*delta^{13}*C)
    )
    cols <- ifelse(cf >= 0, "steelblue4", "firebrick")
    bp <- barplot(cf,
                  col = cols,
                  las = 2,
                  ylab = "Coefficient estimate",
                  main = paste(c(sim_overall = "Overall", sim_DDT = "DDT")[nm], "trophic model"),
                  names.arg = rep("", length(cf)))
    axis(1, at = bp, labels = names(cf), las = 2)
    abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey50")
  }

  if (exists("compare_cv") && !is.null(compare_cv) && nrow(compare_cv) > 0) {
    gulf <- compare_cv[compare_cv$`Held-out area` == "Gulf of Alaska", ]
    mean_rows <- compare_cv[compare_cv$`Held-out area` == "Mean across held-out areas", ]

    plot_df <- rbind(gulf, mean_rows)
    plot_df$group <- paste(plot_df$Response, plot_df$`Held-out area`, sep = "\n")
    groups <- unique(plot_df$group)
    models <- unique(plot_df$Model)
    rmse_mat <- sapply(models, function(model) plot_df$RMSE[match(groups, plot_df$group[plot_df$Model == model])])
    r2_mat <- sapply(models, function(model) plot_df$Predictive_R2[match(groups, plot_df$group[plot_df$Model == model])])
    if (is.null(dim(rmse_mat))) rmse_mat <- matrix(rmse_mat, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(groups, models))
    if (is.null(dim(r2_mat))) r2_mat <- matrix(r2_mat, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(groups, models))

    barplot(t(rmse_mat), beside = TRUE,
            col = c("grey55", "darkgreen")[seq_len(ncol(rmse_mat))],
            names.arg = groups,
            las = 2,
            ylab = "RMSE",
            main = "Baseline vs trophic model transfer RMSE")
    legend("topright", bty = "n", fill = c("grey55", "darkgreen")[seq_len(ncol(rmse_mat))], legend = colnames(rmse_mat))

    barplot(t(r2_mat), beside = TRUE,
            col = c("grey55", "darkgreen")[seq_len(ncol(r2_mat))],
            names.arg = groups,
            las = 2,
            ylab = expression(R^2),
            main = "Baseline vs trophic model transfer predictive fit")
    legend("topleft", bty = "n", fill = c("grey55", "darkgreen")[seq_len(ncol(r2_mat))], legend = colnames(r2_mat))
  } else {
    plot.new(); title("Transfer RMSE comparison")
    plot.new(); title("Transfer predictive fit comparison")
  }
}
```

## 16) Conclusion: Main Drivers of Contamination Variation

```{r conclusion-driver-values, include=FALSE}
driver_table <- NULL
if (exists("st_out") && !is.null(st_out) && nrow(st_out) > 0) {
  driver_table <- st_out
}

space_rank <- time_rank <- interaction_rank <- NA_character_
if (!is.null(driver_table)) {
  ord_space <- order(abs(driver_table$dist_coef), decreasing = TRUE)
  ord_time  <- order(abs(driver_table$time_coef), decreasing = TRUE)
  ord_int   <- order(abs(driver_table$interaction_coef), decreasing = TRUE)
  space_rank <- paste(driver_table$response[ord_space], collapse = " > ")
  time_rank <- paste(driver_table$response[ord_time], collapse = " > ")
  interaction_rank <- paste(driver_table$response[ord_int], collapse = " > ")
}
```

Across contaminants and isotopes, the dominant source of variation is **space**: chemical
similarity decreases with increasing geographic distance, and this spatial decay is strongest
for DDT-family chemistry and strongest overall in the multivariate index.

The second driver is **contaminant class and transport behavior**:

- DDT-family patterns are steep and typically best described by exponential decay, consistent
  with spatially localized or regionally concentrated sources plus distance attenuation.
- PCP/PCB patterns are shallower, consistent with broader transport and mixing.
- Isotopes show smoother, more gradient-like structure (often better log-linear support),
  indicating broad foraging/habitat transitions rather than sharply bounded sources.

The third driver is **time and space-time coupling**:

- Temporal lags contribute additional variation, but usually less than distance.
- The joint space-time model indicates that distance-decay strength can shift with temporal
  separation (interaction term), meaning spatial structure is not fully time-stationary.

The fourth driver is **species/ecology context**:

- Species-level fits show different slope magnitudes and best functional forms,
  implying trophic ecology and movement behavior modulate exposure patterns.
- In this dataset, high-pair species (especially *Uria* spp.) dominate signal strength,
  so future inference should balance species representation.

### Practical take-away for predictive modeling

For prediction, prioritize a **spatiotemporal model** where contamination is modeled as a
function of distance structure, year (or lag), and species effects simultaneously (for example,
GAM or mixed-effects spatial model with spatial cross-validation by area). This workflow is
best aligned with the evidence in this report: space is the strongest axis, time is informative,
and species modifies both.

If a single concise ranking is needed for this report, it is:

1. Geographic distance (spatial structure)
2. Contaminant chemistry class (DDT vs PCB/PCP vs isotope behavior)
3. Time (collection year / pairwise lag)
4. Species ecological differences

```{r graphics-gallery, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
pretty_title <- function(fp) {
  nm <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fp))
  nm <- gsub("-1$", "", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^plotting$", "Dummy distance-decay panels", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^generality$", "Generality across response types", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^real_testcase_distance_decay_plots$", "Real-data distance-decay fits", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^real-binned-ci$", "Binned mean similarity with 95% CI", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^real-null-slopes$", "Observed versus null slope distributions", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^real-null-decay-bands$", "Observed versus null decay bands", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^fitted-curves-plot$", "Functional-form comparison", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^gam-spatial$", "GAM spatial prediction", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^temporal-trend$", "Temporal trends", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^spatiotemporal-visualization$", "Distance-decay by time-lag tercile", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^dyadic-mixed-graphics$", "Dyadic mixed-model diagnostics", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^dyadic-trophic-graphics$", "Trophic mixed-model diagnostics", nm)
  nm <- gsub("^species-breakdown-", "Species breakdown ", nm)
  gsub("-", " ", nm)
}

for (fp in gallery_files) {
  cat("\n\n### ", pretty_title(fp), "\n\n", sep = "")
```
